    (phase1 : PqxdhServerAuthNegativeControl.Phase1ReadBack codec)

        PqxdhRegistrationJointKemRawBridge.KeyMatchFinal setup codec checks (selectedKem budget g) final)) <$>
      ((fun result => (result.1.map (PqxdhRegistrationJointInitializedSchedule.encodeOutcome setup), result.2)) <$>
        (PqxdhRegistrationJointInitializedSchedule.source setup codec checks ensureInit none
          (PqxdhRegistrationJointAcceptCutTag.tag (compileFull setup codec route bounds mode adversary) g.1.val)).run

    PqxdhRegistrationJointOpenUniform.total caps (PqxdhDeploymentCompileCaps.transported bounds budget) =
      (budget.coin + budget.test + budget.freshBytes bounds) + 32 * budget.create + 32 * budget.bundle +

    (designated : PqxdhDeploymentTranscript.designate setup.source.crypto codec setup.serverKeyId
      observed.2.1.transcript handle = some (session, k)) :
    session < budget.accept ∧ k < budget.capacity
exact_statements.PqxdhDeploymentTargetRange.designateIn_r:
theorem designateIn_range (crypto : Pqxdh.Crypto) (codec : Codec Reader Response) (serverKid : Std.U64) (budget : Budget)
    (transcript : List Entry) (handle : Handle) (session k : Nat)
    (designated : PqxdhDeploymentTranscript.designate crypto codec serverKid transcript handle = some (session, k))
    (sessionBound : session < budget.accept) (kBound : k < budget.capacity) :
    PqxdhDeploymentTranscript.designateIn crypto codec serverKid budget transcript handle =
      some (⟨session, sessionBound⟩, ⟨k, kBound⟩)
exact_statements.PqxdhDeploymentTargetRange.eligible_desi:
theorem eligible_designated (setup : Setup baseSpec KemSK) (codec : Codec Reader Response) (checks : Checks)
    (route : RawCtxServerRouting.SenderDecoder) (ensureInit : StateT A ProbComp Bool)
    (phase1 : PqxdhServerAuthNegativeControl.Phase1ReadBack codec)
    (phase2 : PqxdhServerAuthNegativeControl.Phase2ReadBack codec) (bounds : FreshBounds) (mode : Mode)
    (adversary : OracleComp (ModeSpec mode) X) (budget : Budget) (respects : budget.Respects adversary) (runtime : A)
    (claim : PqxdhDeploymentKemTransfer.Observed X → Option Handle)
    (outcome : Option (PqxdhRegistrationJointServerBirth.ClientCreated Unit × X × PqxdhDeploymentSecrecy.State KemSK) × A)
    (reached : outcome ∈ support ((PqxdhDeploymentSecrecy.game setup codec checks route ensureInit 0 bounds mode
      adversary).run runtime)) :
    (eligible setup.source.crypto codec setup.serverKeyId claim outcome).isSome =
      (PqxdhDeploymentKemTransfer.designated setup.source.crypto codec setup.serverKeyId budget claim outcome).isSome
exact_statements.PqxdhDeploymentTargetRange.kem_transfer_:
theorem kem_transfer_eligible (setup : Setup baseSpec KemSK)
    (functional : PqxdhChallengeSecretRouting.FunctionalDecapsulation setup.kem)
    (codec : Codec Reader Response) (checks : Checks) (route : RawCtxServerRouting.SenderDecoder)
    (ensureInit : StateT A ProbComp Bool) (phase1 : PqxdhServerAuthNegativeControl.Phase1ReadBack codec)
    (phase2 : PqxdhServerAuthNegativeControl.Phase2ReadBack codec) (bounds : FreshBounds) (mode : Mode)
    (adversary : OracleComp (ModeSpec mode) X) (budget : Budget) (respects : budget.Respects adversary)
    (event : PqxdhDeploymentKemTransfer.Observed X → Bool)
    (claim : PqxdhDeploymentKemTransfer.Observed X → Option Handle) (runtime : A) :
    𝒟[(fun outcome => decide (PqxdhDeploymentKemTransfer.happens event outcome = true ∧
        (eligible setup.source.crypto codec setup.serverKeyId claim outcome).isSome)) <$>
      (PqxdhDeploymentSecrecy.game setup codec checks route ensureInit 0 bounds mode adversary).run runtime] {true} ≤
      ∑ g : Fin budget.accept × Fin budget.capacity,
        (𝒟[PqxdhRegistrationJointKemRawOpaque.opaqueBranch setup codec checks ensureInit none
          (PqxdhDeploymentKemTransfer.decision setup.source.crypto codec setup.serverKeyId budget event claim g)
          (compileFull setup codec route bounds mode adversary) runtime budget.create
          (PqxdhDeploymentKemTransfer.selectedKem budget g) g.1.val false] {true} +
        ENNReal.ofReal (setup.kem.IND_CCA_Advantage (PqxdhInitializerSecrecy.runtimeOfImpl
            (PqxdhInitializerSecrecy.kemAmbientImpl setup.baseImpl))
          (PqxdhRegistrationJointKemRawCertified.adversary setup codec checks ensureInit none
            (PqxdhDeploymentKemTransfer.decision setup.source.crypto codec setup.serverKeyId budget event claim g)
            (compileFull setup codec route bounds mode adversary) runtime budget.create
            (PqxdhDeploymentKemTransfer.selectedKem budget g) g.1.val).toINDCCA +
          PqxdhRegistrationJointKemRawGame.correctnessError setup))

exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentRegistrationTrace.Logged:
inductive Logged where
  | accept (raw : Pqxdh.Bytes) (reply : Option Nat)
  | bundle (owner : Nat) (reply : Option Pqxdh.Bytes)
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentRegistrationTrace.record:
def record : (query : (Spec KemSK).Domain) → (Spec KemSK).Range query → List Logged → List Logged
  | .inl (.inr (.accept raw)), reply, log => log ++ [.accept raw reply]
  | .inl (.inr (.bundle owner)), reply, log => log ++ [.bundle owner reply]
  | _, _, log => log
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentRegistrationTrace.logImpl:
def logImpl : QueryImpl (Spec KemSK) (StateT (List Logged) (OracleComp (Spec KemSK))) := fun query log =>
  (fun reply => (reply, record query reply log)) <$> ((Spec KemSK).query query : OracleComp (Spec KemSK) _)
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentRegistrationTrace.accepts:
def acceptsOf (log : List Logged) : List (Pqxdh.Bytes × Option Nat) :=
  log.filterMap fun event => match event with
    | .accept raw reply => some (raw, reply)
    | .bundle _ _ => none
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentRegistrationTrace.Pooled:
def Pooled (codec : Codec Reader Response) (k : Nat) (bytes : Pqxdh.Bytes)
    (state : PqxdhRegistrationJointSchedule.State KemSK) : Prop :=
  ∃ (identity : PqxdhEd25519EufCma.Ed25519PublicKey) (keys : PqxdhEd25519EufCma.Phase1KeyTuple)
    (preSignature oneSignature pqSignature : PqxdhEd25519EufCma.Ed25519Signature),
    codec.write1 (PqxdhJointPhase1SourceWriter.candidate identity keys preSignature oneSignature pqSignature) = some bytes ∧
      (state.pool.2.keys[k]?).map Prod.fst = some keys.pqKey
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentRegistrationTrace.Traced:
structure Traced (setup : Setup baseSpec KemSK) (codec : Codec Reader Response) (checks : Checks)
    (log : List Logged) (state : PqxdhRegistrationJointSchedule.State KemSK) : Prop where
  sessions : state.shared.2.sessions = (acceptsOf log).length
  positional : ∀ (position : Nat) (raw : Pqxdh.Bytes) (session : Nat),
    (acceptsOf log)[position]? = some (raw, some session) → session = position
  verified : ∀ (raw : Pqxdh.Bytes) (session : Nat), (raw, some session) ∈ acceptsOf log →
    ∃ value, PqxdhRegistrationJointRawSignatures.verified setup codec checks raw = some value
  bundles : ∀ (k : Nat) (bytes : Pqxdh.Bytes), Logged.bundle k (some bytes) ∈ log → Pooled codec k bytes state
  kem : PqxdhDeploymentKemIndex.Positional state
  owned : PqxdhRegistrationJointSchedule.Invariant state
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentKemTransfer.regOf:
def regOf : Entry → Option Logged
  | ⟨.inl (.inr (.accept raw)), reply⟩ => some (.accept raw reply)
  | ⟨.inl (.inr (.bundle owner)), reply⟩ => some (.bundle owner reply)
  | _ => none
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentKemTransfer.registrations: def registrations (transcript : List Entry) : List Logged := transcript.filterMap regOf
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentKemTransfer.Observed: abbrev Observed (X : Type) := X × Ledger × List (FrameTag × PqxdhDeploymentNative.Frame)
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentKemTransfer.observeCompil: def observeCompiled (result : (X × Ledger) × Local) : Observed X := (result.1.1, result.1.2, result.2.produced)
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentKemTransfer.observeGame:
def observeGame (outcome : Option (PqxdhRegistrationJointServerBirth.ClientCreated Unit × X ×
    PqxdhDeploymentSecrecy.State KemSK)) : Option (Observed X) :=
  outcome.map fun result => (result.2.1, result.2.2.1, result.2.2.2.produced)
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentKemTransfer.target:
noncomputable def target (crypto : Pqxdh.Crypto) (codec : Codec Reader Response) (serverKid : Std.U64) (budget : Budget)
    (claim : Observed X → Option Handle) (observed : Observed X) : Option (Fin budget.accept × Fin budget.capacity) :=
  (claim observed).bind (PqxdhDeploymentTranscript.designateIn crypto codec serverKid budget observed.2.1.transcript)
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentKemTransfer.decision:
noncomputable def decision (crypto : Pqxdh.Crypto) (codec : Codec Reader Response) (serverKid : Std.U64) (budget : Budget)
    (event : Observed X → Bool) (claim : Observed X → Option Handle) (g : Fin budget.accept × Fin budget.capacity)
    (result : (X × Ledger) × Local) : Bool :=
  event (observeCompiled result) && decide (target crypto codec serverKid budget claim (observeCompiled result) = some g)
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentKemTransfer.happens:
def happens (event : Observed X → Bool) (outcome : Option (PqxdhRegistrationJointServerBirth.ClientCreated Unit × X ×
    PqxdhDeploymentSecrecy.State KemSK) × A) : Bool :=
  (observeGame outcome.1).any event
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentKemTransfer.designated:
noncomputable def designated (crypto : Pqxdh.Crypto) (codec : Codec Reader Response) (serverKid : Std.U64) (budget : Budget)
    (claim : Observed X → Option Handle) (outcome : Option (PqxdhRegistrationJointServerBirth.ClientCreated Unit × X ×
      PqxdhDeploymentSecrecy.State KemSK) × A) : Option (Fin budget.accept × Fin budget.capacity) :=
  (observeGame outcome.1).bind (target crypto codec serverKid budget claim)
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentKemTransfer.selectedKem:
def selectedKem (budget : Budget) (g : Fin budget.accept × Fin budget.capacity) : Fin (budget.create + 1) :=
  ⟨g.2.val, g.2.isLt⟩
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentTargetRange.classCount:
def classCount (kind : Fin 14) (transcript : List Entry) : Nat :=
  transcript.countP fun entry => decide (queryClass entry.query = kind)
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentTargetRange.eligible:
noncomputable def eligible (crypto : Pqxdh.Crypto) (codec : Codec Reader Response) (serverKid : Std.U64)
    (claim : PqxdhDeploymentKemTransfer.Observed X → Option Handle)
    (outcome : Option (PqxdhRegistrationJointServerBirth.ClientCreated Unit × X × PqxdhDeploymentSecrecy.State KemSK) × A) :
    Option (Nat × Nat) :=
  (PqxdhDeploymentKemTransfer.observeGame outcome.1).bind fun observed =>
    (claim observed).bind (PqxdhDeploymentTranscript.designate crypto codec serverKid observed.2.1.transcript)

main_results.bills: PqxdhDeploymentKemTransfer.kem_transfer_bills: KemRawBills.adversary_bound at transported bounds budget (prechallenge (qInit + 32) + (keygenCost * qCreate + V), decapsBase * qFinish, qFinish; postchallenge V, decapsBase * qFinish, qFinish; V = uniformCap caps qCreate qFinish (OpenUniform.total caps (transported bounds budget)) qAccept); transported_total gives OpenUniform.total in closed form.

deviations_from_plan: Step 9.1 is proved as the equality the plan states. KeyMatchFinal and the accepted conjunct are obtained by tracing (reply provenance through a logging transformation) rather than an annotated version of the CE-3 per-step relation; the program-level facts need no handler and the handler-level invariant Traced is generic in the program.

The experiment is stated at Server identity index 0, the Server slot of the empty identity pool from which T4 starts; compile_full_source gives the experiment the seed count of the starting pool. Other indices are not claimed (no invariance lemma), as for unit 3 published-tuple statements.

Events read the adversary output, the ledger (including the hidden bit and fresh messages) and the produced frames (Observed); the claim function is arbitrary, so the bounds hold for every claim, including public selections such as the first test handle.
The headline has one KEM adversary per target (exact sum); the N * Adv(B_guess) form is not provided (owner input 5).
The designation range lemma (unit A open point) is added, so the headline also holds with unbudgeted eligibility.
No planned statement turned out false or unprovable and no statement was weakened; no existing module changed.
